test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DECK' is coded as 'WVXP', and 'CLAIM' is coded as 'XOZRN'. How will 'MASCOT' be written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86cc13096ed6331811217d835ffcf5acfdb323f2fe9033cd679a1725387c361f.png] 

 
• 'DECK' is coded as 'WVXP'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09a90d1950c26bdfb3a4e8a2ef88f80d9ac99b0a69bffd8df28ce19535ba87d1.png] 

and,

 
• 'CLAIM' is coded as 'XOZRN'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/077de516e5b77a51a34dd66a548c02150b5bf56878bab57b6b19bed8e1bcdcdd.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **'MASCOT' will be coded as :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6e80b745f7c02287b0a38b138960d5a5bfffd925ce93b16a73ee65a6331768f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"NZHXLG".**
